questions.question: What is the nature of much of Psalm 109?
options: A glad hymn praising the wonders and the glories of God's creation
A thanksgiving offered for a great and entirely unexpected deliverance
A solemn meditation upon the shortness and frailty of human life
An appeal against false accusers and a curse upon a wicked adversary
questions.answer: An appeal against false accusers and a curse upon a wicked adversary
